Synopsis:
AOM/OOM dialog with the prisoners in Cazador's Palace. Astarion meets Sebastian - a young man he seduced and brought to Cazador - for the first time in 170 years. Astarion was sure Sebastian was dead, but Cazador secretly turned him into a vampire spawn. If you aggrevate Sebastian, he'll be so full of hate and pain that he'll curse you.

context: Astarion and the party have come to Cazador’s Palace to confront the vampire lord and find a cellblock full of emaciated, pale vampire spawn marked with carved rune scars. One prisoner, Sebastian, is someone Astarion seduced and delivered to Cazador roughly 170 years ago; Astarion believed him dead, but Cazador secretly made him a vampire spawn. Sebastian recognizes Astarion, pleads to hear his name, and—when reminded of his betrayal or denied—erupts in bitter rage and grief, damning Astarion and the party. The scene assumes the party must decide what to do about Cazador and the changed prisoners; provoking Sebastian can drive him to issue a hateful curse.
